guide.create: Enter your nickname, choose the settings, then create a room. Share its code with your friends.
guide.join: Enter your nickname and the six-character code you received to join the room.
guide.disconnected: The connection was lost. Check your internet; the game is trying to reconnect automatically.
guide.finished: The game is over. The winner is shown, and you can create a new game.
guide.invite: Share the room code. At least two connected players are needed to start.
guide.start: Everyone is ready. As host, press Start game.
guide.waitHost: Wait for the host to start the round.
guide.spin: Get ready: the letter and category will appear in a moment.
guide.spectate: This round has already started. You can answer in the next one.
guide.retrySave: Your answer was not saved. Try again before STOP.
guide.saved: Your answer is saved. You can change it until STOP.
guide.answer: Find a word in the category “{category}” starting with {letter}. Press Enter to save it before STOP.
guide.decide: The votes are tied. Use Valid or Incorrect to decide the indicated answer.
guide.vote: Read the other players' answers and choose Valid, Incorrect or Unsure for each one.
guide.waitVotes: Voting is still in progress. It can close after 30 seconds.
guide.showResults: The votes are ready. Press Show results.
guide.waitResults: Voting is complete. Wait for the host to show the results.
guide.nextRound: Press Next round to continue the game.
guide.waitNext: Wait for the host to start the next round.

help.title: Bakalorea help
help.subtitle: Game guide
help.welcome: Hi! Ask me about Bakalorea or choose a topic below.

answer.start: Create a room with your nickname. Share the code with another player, then the host starts once two people are connected.
answer.join: Choose Join, enter your nickname and the six-character code shared by the host. If the game has already started, you can play in the next round.
answer.answer: The game shows a category and a letter. Enter a matching word that starts with that letter, then press Enter or the check mark before STOP. You can edit it while time remains.
answer.vote: After STOP, vote on each other player's answer: Valid, Incorrect or Unsure. You cannot vote on your own answer. A referee breaks tied votes.
answer.score: An accepted answer earns the room's unique points, or duplicate points if multiple players wrote the same answer. The first player to reach the target with a lead wins.
answer.connection: Check your internet connection and keep the page open. The game reconnects automatically. If your session moved to another tab, choose Resume here.
answer.noGame: Join or create a room so I can read your current game information.
answer.roomCode: Your room code is {code}. Share it with anyone who wants to join.
answer.myScore: You have {score} points. The target for this game is {target} points.
answer.players: There are currently {count} connected players in the room.
answer.settings: The target is {target} points. Each answer lasts {duration} seconds. A unique answer earns {unique} points and a duplicate earns {duplicate} points.
answer.noRound: No round has started yet. The host can start once two players are connected.
answer.noTimer: The answer timer is not running right now.
answer.leaderTied: Several players are tied for the lead with {score} points.
answer.host: The host starts rounds and shows results. If their device is absent for 45 seconds, a connected player becomes the host.
answer.unknown: I can explain creating a game, room codes, answers, voting and points. Choose a topic below or rephrase your question.

intro: Play, laugh, and challenge family and friends together.
homeMessage: People often say technology pulls families apart and gradually replaces real moments together. This game was created to do exactly the opposite: turn technology into a reason to get together, laugh, challenge one another, make memories, and strengthen the bonds between family and friends.
joinActiveHint: You can join a game already in progress. You’ll play in the next round.
rule1: Everyone gets the same category and a randomly selected letter.
rule2: Write your answer before STOP. It stays secret until time runs out.
rule3: Vote on everyone else’s answers, then see the scores.
scoring: A valid answer earns 10 points, or 5 for a duplicate. First to 200 wins!
lobbyText: Share the code, gather your family and start the first round.
waitingHost: The host will start the round.
waitingMusicSoundOff: Turn on sound at the top to listen.
musicAutoplayHint: If the song does not start, press Play in the player.
needPlayers: At least 2 connected players are needed to start.
leaveText: You can return to this seat on this device. Your points will stay on the scoreboard.
notSaved: Answer not saved. Try again before STOP.
privateAnswer: Your answer stays secret until STOP.
pressEnter: Press Enter to save your answer.
stopText: Answers are locked. Time to judge!
judgingStopHelp: Time to judge: vote on the other players’ answers.
googleCheckAnswer: Search Google for “{answer}” to check this answer
strictReason: Left the screen: 0 points in strict mode
votesPending: Waiting for votes. Voting can close after 30 seconds.
tiesPending: Resolve tied votes before showing results.
resultsText: This round’s points have been awarded.
winnerText: A great game deserves a rematch.
tiebreak: A tie at the top! Time for another round.
sessionReplaced: This seat is being used in another tab.
soundBlocked: Enable sound using the button at the top.
stayFocused: Stay on this screen during the round.
softHelp: Leaving the screen is logged without a penalty.
normalHelp: Leaving the screen is flagged during judging.
strictHelp: Leaving the screen while answering disqualifies your answer.
tieHelp: The host breaks ties. Another player decides ties on the host’s own answer.
spectating: You’ll play in the next round.
waitingResults: Waiting for the host to show results.
chatEmpty: No messages yet. Start the conversation!
chatFailed: Could not send. Your message is saved.
leaveFailed: Unable to leave. Try again once reconnected.

error.generic: That didn’t work. Check the fields and try again.
error.network: Can’t reach the server. Check your connection.
error.not_found: Room not found. Check the code.
error.unauthorized: Your session expired. Create or join a game.
error.rate_limit: Please wait a moment and try again.
error.host_only: Only the host can do that.
error.need_players: At least 2 connected players are needed.
error.answer_closed: Time is up. Your last saved answer has been kept.
error.invalid_letters: Choose at least two different letters.
error.session_replaced: This seat is being used in another tab.
error.wrong_game: You’re not a member of this room.
